title: Profit crafting
subtitle: Crafts for every budget in 3.30, with more than one way to make each
summary: Pick the tier that matches your bankroll and move up as it grows. On day 1, craft cheap things levelers need. From day 2 or 3, switch to batch crafts like Rog items and medium cluster jewels. In week 2, put real money into fossils and Eldritch implicits. Influence and mirror-tier crafts come later, once you have hundreds of divines.

phases.crafts: Flasks, MS boots, resistance jewellery, Vaal gem corruptions
phases.why: Everyone is leveling and gear is scarce

phases.crafts: Rog crafts from Expedition, essence boots and belts
phases.why: Your atlas already farms the materials

phases.crafts: Medium cluster jewels, +1/+2 caster wands, RF gloves and boots
phases.why: Steady demand from builds that are already working

changes.title: More good drops
changes.body: Endgame rares now drop unidentified with a tier, and rarity improves every type of drop. Plain 3-mod rares lose value faster, so craft items that drops can't easily replace.

changes.title: Bench locks cost divines
changes.body: Protecting one prefix or suffix costs 1 div, or 2 div for two. A full lock costs 4 div plus a Sacred Orb (weapons), 4 Blessed Orbs (armour) or 8 Exalted Orbs (jewellery).

changes.title: No Allflame crafting
changes.body: Strands and Ducats aren't going core, so the 3.29 strand crafts in many videos won't work. The routes here use methods that still exist.

changes.title: Corrupt twice
changes.body: The Altar of Corruption and the Lapidary Lens can corrupt an already corrupted item or gem again. The Lens can also destroy it.

changes.title: Recombinator rules
changes.body: The result keeps the item level of the base you pick, and corrupted items can't go in at all.

changes.title: Fractured items, harder and easier
changes.body: Most league sources of fractured items are gone, but Tier 5 magic items can now drop fractured. Veiled mods come from Betrayal.

crafts.name: Utility flasks
crafts.base: Quicksilver, Silver, Jade, Granite, Diamond
steps: Transmute, then alteration and augment spam until you hit a useful suffix
Add quality with Glassblower's Baubles
Bench craft the finish
crafts.targets: A useful suffix (movement speed on Quicksilver, Onslaught on Silver, bleed or freeze immunity) plus a duration or effect prefix, at 20% quality
crafts.buyers: Everyone mapping on days 1 to 3

alts.name: Buy half-done flasks
alts.why: Faster once trade fills up on day 2. Skip the alt spam and finish the other side.
steps: Search trade for magic utility flasks with the prefix you want and an open suffix
Orb of Augmentation for the suffix, alteration only if it misses badly
Quality to 20% with Glassblower's Baubles and list

crafts.name: Movement-speed boots
crafts.base: Any boots with life or ES
steps: Vendor recipe: magic boots + Quicksilver Flask + Orb of Augmentation adds movement speed
Essence or bench craft resistances
Bench craft life if a prefix is open
crafts.targets: 20%+ movement speed, life or ES, 2 resistances
crafts.buyers: Levelers and first mappers

alts.name: Shuddering Fossil
alts.why: More speed mods, so movement speed shows up far more often.
steps: Shuddering Fossil in a Primitive Chaotic Resonator
Keep movement speed plus life or a resistance
Bench craft the rest

crafts.name: Resistance rings and belts
crafts.base: Amethyst rings, Leather or Heavy belts
steps: Chaos reforge, or use the bench craft that rerolls 3 mods for 3 Chaos Orbs
Bench craft the missing resistance
crafts.targets: Life plus 2 to 3 resistances
crafts.buyers: Anyone fixing resistances after Kitava

alts.name: Alt and regal two-stone rings
alts.why: Two-stone rings already carry two resistances, so you only need life and one more res.
steps: Buy ilvl 75+ two-stone rings with the res pair you want
Orbs of Alteration until life plus a resistance
Regal, then bench craft a resistance or attributes in the open slot

crafts.name: Essence league-start armour
crafts.base: Any ilvl 68+ body armour, helmet or boots in the common base for its stat
crafts.sale: 5 to 30c each, fast sellers on day 1 and 2
steps: Essence of Greed for guaranteed life
Keep any roll with 2 resistances alongside
Bench craft the last resistance and list cheap in bulk
crafts.targets: Life plus 2 or 3 resistances
crafts.buyers: Players finishing the campaign and their first white maps
crafts.note: Based on XTheFarmerX's cheap league-start gear videos, which are for PoE2. The same idea works in PoE1 with essences.

alts.name: Alt and regal
alts.why: Cheaper when essences are scarce on day 1.
steps: Orbs of Alteration until life and a resistance
Regal, then bench craft a second resistance

alts.name: Chaos reforge
alts.why: No thinking needed. Fine when Chaos Orbs are cheap compared to essences.
steps: Chaos Orbs until life plus 2 resistances
Bench craft whatever is missing

crafts.name: Life and damage jewels
crafts.base: ilvl 75+ Crimson, Viridian or Cobalt Jewel
crafts.sale: 10c to 3 div for 3 to 4 good mods
steps: Orbs of Alteration until % max life (or % ES on Cobalt) plus a matching damage mod
Regal for a third mod
Exalt only on jewels with three good mods
crafts.targets: % life or ES plus crit multi, damage over time multi or attack speed
crafts.buyers: Every build, all league
crafts.note: Belton's long-running jewel crafting guide argues jewels scale well into late game, which keeps demand steady.

alts.name: Chaos reforge
alts.why: Faster, and good for 4-mod jackpots, but you hit the right pair less often.
steps: Chaos Orbs on rare jewels
Keep anything with life plus two good mods

alts.name: Buy magic 2-mod jewels
alts.why: On days 2 to 4 trade is full of magic jewels that only need a regal.
steps: Buy magic jewels with life plus a good damage mod
Regal, then exalt if the third mod is good

crafts.name: Vaal gem corruptions
crafts.base: 20% quality gems people actually play
steps: Open the Gem Vaal & levelling tab
Vaal only the gems it marks as positive EV
Sell 21/20s quickly while the skill is popular
crafts.buyers: Players buying perfect gems for their main skill

alts.name: Buy and resell 21/20s
alts.why: Less risk: buy underpriced corrupted gems and relist them.
steps: Watch poe.ninja for 21/20 gems listed under their usual price
Buy a few and relist at the normal price

crafts.name: 20% quality gems
crafts.base: Level 20 gems with 0 to 10% quality, for skills meta builds use
crafts.sale: 5c to 1 div over the raw gem
steps: Buy level 20 gems with low quality from trade
Gemcutter's Prisms up to 20% quality
List as 20/20, or Vaal it if the gem is cheap (see the Vaal gems craft)
crafts.targets: 20/20 versions of meta skills and supports
crafts.buyers: Every player from early maps onward

alts.name: Level your own gems
alts.why: Slower but free: put spare gems in your weapon swap and level them while you map.
steps: Socket extra copies of meta gems in your weapon swap
Quality them once they hit 20
Sell 20/20 or keep them for Vaal attempts

crafts.name: Small cluster jewels
crafts.base: ilvl 75+ Small Cluster Jewels with life, resistance or attribute enchants
crafts.sale: 10c to 2 div for the right notable
steps: Orbs of Alteration until the notable you want lands
Regal for a third mod
Exalt only if both the notable and the extra mods are good
crafts.targets: A strong life or resistance notable with an extra % life mod
crafts.buyers: Builds that fill out their cluster wheels

alts.name: Chaos reforge
alts.why: Faster when alterations are short. Fine because small clusters only roll one notable.
steps: Chaos Orbs on rare small clusters until the notable lands
Sell straight away

crafts.name: Leveling weapons
crafts.base: ilvl 30 to 70 one-handers and bows, the type the popular league starters use
crafts.sale: 5 to 30c each, sells all of day 1
steps: Essence of Contempt for guaranteed flat physical damage
Keep rolls with % physical damage or attack speed alongside
Bench craft a damage mod in any open slot
crafts.targets: Flat phys plus % phys or attack speed
crafts.buyers: Players who rushed the campaign or rolled a second character

alts.name: Alt and regal
alts.why: Cheap and fine for low-level bases.
steps: Orbs of Alteration until % phys plus flat phys
Regal and bench craft

alts.name: Caster version
alts.why: Same idea for spell starters: +1 wands and sceptres.
steps: Alteration spam for +1 to fire, cold or lightning gems plus spell damage
Regal, then bench craft cast speed

crafts.name: Life and resistance belts
crafts.base: ilvl 75+ Leather Belt, Heavy Belt or Stygian Vise
steps: Essence of Greed for guaranteed life
Keep anything with two resistances or strength alongside
Bench craft the missing resistance
crafts.targets: High life, two resistances, strength or flask mods
crafts.buyers: Every life build, and Stygian Vise for abyss jewel users

alts.name: Alt and regal
alts.why: Cheaper on day 1 when essences cost more.
steps: Orbs of Alteration until life plus a resistance
Regal, then bench craft a resistance

alts.name: Chaos reforge Stygian Vises
alts.why: Vises sell higher, so the extra rerolls pay for themselves.
steps: Chaos Orbs until life plus two resistances
Bench craft the last mod

crafts.name: Vaal Orb unique flips
crafts.base: Cheap uniques whose corrupted implicits make them much better (popular league-start uniques)
crafts.cost: 1 Vaal Orb per unique plus the unique
crafts.sale: Big hits sell for 5 to 50 times the base
steps: Buy a stack of one cheap unique
Vaal Orb each one
Sell the good implicits and the extra-socket or extra-link hits, vendor or list the rest cheap
crafts.targets: Strong corrupted implicits or 6 links on meta uniques
crafts.buyers: Players who want the corrupted version without the gamble

alts.name: Pick by poe.ninja
alts.why: Only gamble on uniques where the corrupted version is listed for far more than the plain one.
steps: Compare corrupted and plain prices on poe.ninja
Choose uniques where 1 in 4 hits pays for the stack
Do batches of 10 to 20 so luck evens out

crafts.name: Sort tiered rare drops
crafts.base: Unidentified rares that show a high tier on the ground in 3.30
crafts.sale: 10c to several div per good drop
steps: Set your loot filter to show high-tier unidentified rares of popular base types
Identify them with Scrolls of Wisdom in town
Price-check anything with 3+ good mods and sell it, or use it as a crafting base
crafts.targets: Drops crafters and players want as they are
crafts.buyers: Everyone

alts.name: Use them as bases
alts.why: A good drop with an open affix is a cheap start for any craft on this page.
steps: Keep tiered drops with 2 or 3 great mods and open slots
Finish them with an exalt or a bench craft

crafts.note: This isn't crafting, but in 3.30 rarity now affects what drops, so good rares are worth picking up again.

crafts.name: Rog crafting (Expedition)
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ rings, belts and evasion helmets (best). Evasion boots and evasion/armour gloves next
steps: Fill suffixes with Rog's adding option, leaving a prefix open for bench-crafted life
Reroll the side you're targeting and always take tier upgrades
Use Divine near the end, once the item looks good
Bench craft the missing life, or annul a bad mod to make room
Don't skip options without thinking: skipping raises the artifact cost and can force an option that bricks the item
crafts.targets: Life, resistances and attributes on jewellery; spell suppression with resistances or life on helmets, boots and gloves
crafts.buyers: Everyone rounding out resistances and suppression
crafts.note: Run logbooks at ilvl 75+ with 65%+ quantity, and spend explosives on artifact chests first. Rog needs character level 90 to offer ilvl 86+ bases.

alts.name: Tujen and Gwennen
alts.why: Tujen sells currency and Gwennen now offers a crafting service in 3.30, so spread your logbook loot across them.
steps: Spend some artifacts with Tujen on currency you craft with
Try Gwennen's new crafting service on day 1 to see if it pays
Keep Rog for ilvl 86 bases

crafts.name: Medium cluster jewels
crafts.base: Medium Cluster Jewels at the item level the notables need
crafts.cost: About 70c each, 5 div for a batch of 30
steps: Check poe.ninja Builds on day 2 or 3 for the notables the top skills use
Alteration until you hit a wanted notable
Regal, then exalt for the second notable
Price check anything with 2 used notables
crafts.targets: 2 notables a popular build uses (for the Cold DoT archetype, cold and DoT clusters)
crafts.buyers: Builds that have already found their feet
crafts.note: A 3.29 test crafted 30 jewels at about 70c each and sold them for about 8,600c, a profit of roughly 6,000c.

alts.name: Buy 1-notable magic jewels
alts.why: Lets you skip the alteration grind. Best once lots of magic mediums are listed.
steps: Buy magic mediums with one wanted notable and an open affix
Orb of Augmentation for the second notable, or Regal if it already has two mods
Exalt only if both notables landed

alts.name: Harvest reforge
alts.why: If Harvest reforges are still on offer in 3.30, a reforge with the jewel's keyword skips the magic stage.
steps: Check the Harvest station on day 1, since Harvest now spawns in maps instead of the Grove
Reforge with the keyword that matches the notables (for example Critical or Elemental)
Stop when two wanted notables land and sell
alts.note: Harvest prices are set at the station in lifeforce. Watch Vivid and Primal lifeforce prices on the Market tab.

crafts.name: Large cluster jewels (3 notables)
crafts.base: High ilvl Large Cluster, 8 passives, popular enchant (minion, spell, elemental, attack)
crafts.sale: 1 to 30+ div for the meta 3-notable combos
steps: Orbs of Alteration until two wanted notables
Regal for the third mod
Exalt if a slot is open and the first three are right
crafts.targets: The 3 notables the meta builds use, 8 passives so they cost 7 points
crafts.buyers: Minion, spell and DoT builds from week 1
crafts.note: 8 passives with 3 notables is the most popular large cluster setup. Check poe.ninja builds for which notables top players run.

alts.name: Harvest reforge
alts.why: A 3.29 planner put the right Harvest reforge at about 14% per try for a 3-notable minion jewel.
steps: Reforge with the matching keyword (for example Critical)
Keep it when two notables land, fill the open prefix
Only if Harvest reforges still exist in 3.30, so check on day 1

alts.name: Chaos reforge rares
alts.why: Good for enchants with only a few notables, where the odds are high.
steps: Chaos Orbs on rare large clusters
Stop on any 2 or 3 notable combo you know sells

crafts.name: +1/+2 caster wands
crafts.base: Opal or Convoking wands
steps: Alteration for +1 cold spell gems or DoT multiplier
Regal
Bench finish (4-second trigger craft or spell damage)
crafts.targets: +1/+2 cold spell gems, DoT multiplier, spell damage
crafts.buyers: Every cold DoT and spell build, including yours

alts.name: Buy magic +1 wands
alts.why: Lower risk. You pay a little more per base but never miss the +1.
steps: Buy magic wands with +1 to spell skill gems and an open suffix
Regal for a third mod
Bench craft cast speed or spell damage in the open slot

alts.name: Chaos reforge rares
alts.why: Use this for +2 targets on high ilvl bases when you have spare Chaos Orbs.
steps: Chaos Orbs on ilvl 84+ wands until +1 gems plus spell damage
Bench craft the missing mod
Sell 2-mod hits cheap and 3-mod hits high

crafts.name: RF gloves and boots
crafts.base: ilvl 85 gloves with high base percentile
crafts.sale: 50c to 1 div, a few big hits
steps: Essence spam
Fill the open slots with exalts
Annul bad mods
Bench Fire and Chaos resistance
Batch the prefixes across a stack of gloves
crafts.targets: High life, life regeneration, Dexterity
crafts.buyers: Righteous Fire players (RF Chieftain is S-tier on 3.30 league-start lists)
crafts.note: bLut's 3.29 method, at 40 to 50 gloves an hour. These figures come from a video summary and are approximate.

estimate.per: per pair, base and essences not included

alts.name: Essence of Greed base
alts.why: Guarantees life on every roll, so you only chase the resistances.
steps: Essence of Greed on ilvl 84+ armour or ES gloves and boots
Keep anything with life plus two resistances
Exalt or bench craft the last res, annul only on two-res bases

alts.name: Recombinator halves
alts.why: bLut's 3.29 approach. Build life+res halves cheaply, then merge them for the 4 to 5 mod hits.
steps: Make two pairs with the same affix pattern, one with your best prefixes and one with your best suffixes
Recombine in predictable mode
In 3.30 the result keeps the item level of the base you pick, and corrupted items can't go in

crafts.name: 6-link chests
crafts.base: Good rare or unique body armours with 6 sockets but no links
crafts.sale: Usually 1 to 5 div over the unlinked item
steps: Buy chests with 6 sockets but few links
Use the bench 6-link craft (1500 Orbs of Fusing)
Relist at the 6-link price
crafts.targets: Meta uniques and strong rares
crafts.buyers: Players who want to skip the link gamble

alts.name: Spam fusings
alts.why: Cheaper on average than the bench, but you might go over 1500.
steps: Orbs of Fusing one at a time
Stop once it links, then sell

alts.name: Tainted Fusing on corrupted chests
alts.why: Corrupted chests can't use the bench, but Tainted Orbs of Fusing still work.
steps: Buy corrupted chests with good implicits and 6 sockets
Tainted Orbs of Fusing until 6 links, though they can also remove a link
Sell the 6-link corrupted version

crafts.name: Catalyst quality flips
crafts.base: Good rings, amulets and belts with no quality
crafts.sale: Usually 10 to 30% more than the item paid
steps: Buy jewellery with strong mods and 0% quality
Use the Catalyst that matches its best mods up to 20% quality
Relist, since 20% quality boosts those mods by about a fifth
crafts.targets: Life, resistance or damage jewellery that the buyer will use straight away
crafts.buyers: Min-maxers late in week 1

alts.name: Fertile for life
alts.why: Use on jewellery where life is the best mod.
steps: Fertile Catalysts to 20%
Relist

alts.name: Imbued for casters
alts.why: Use on caster amulets and rings with spell mods.
steps: Imbued Catalysts to 20%
Relist

crafts.name: Abyss jewels
crafts.base: ilvl 82+ Murderous, Searching, Hypnotic or Ghastly Eye Jewels
steps: Orbs of Alteration until flat life plus a good damage mod
Regal for a third mod
Exalt only on jewels with three good mods
crafts.targets: Flat life plus 2 or 3 matching damage or minion mods
crafts.buyers: Abyss socket users, minion builds and stackers

alts.name: Chaos reforge
alts.why: Better odds of a 4-mod jackpot, which is where the real money is.
steps: Chaos Orbs until life plus two good mods
Exalt the open slot

alts.name: Buy magic 2-mod jewels
alts.why: Skip the alt grind on days 3+.
steps: Buy magic jewels with life plus a good mod
Regal and exalt

crafts.name: Pristine Fossil life armour
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ armour or hybrid body armours and helmets
steps: Pristine Fossil in a Primitive Chaotic Resonator for more life mods
Keep high life plus two resistances
Bench craft the last resistance
crafts.targets: T1 or T2 life plus resistances, then an Eldritch implicit
crafts.buyers: Life-based meta builds

alts.name: Essence of Greed
alts.why: Guaranteed life every time. Cheaper per roll than fossils.
steps: Essence of Greed until two resistances land alongside
Bench craft, then Eldritch implicits

alts.name: Pristine plus element fossil
alts.why: Pair Pristine with Frigid, Scorched or Metallic to steer which resistance you get.
steps: Pristine and Frigid Fossils in a Potent Chaotic Resonator
Keep life plus the matching resistance

crafts.name: Eldritch implicit flips
crafts.base: Good rare gloves, boots and helmets listed with no implicits
crafts.sale: 1 to 10 div more than you paid
steps: Buy strong rares that have no Eldritch implicits
Greater Eldritch Ember and Ichor until both sides are useful
Relist with the implicits, priced like similar items
crafts.targets: Implicits that match the item's build, for example life or damage
crafts.buyers: Players upgrading their gear in week 1 and 2

alts.name: Lesser for budget items
alts.why: Cheap items only need a cheap implicit to sell faster.
steps: Lesser Eldritch Ember and Ichor
Stop on anything usable

crafts.name: Corrupted implicit jewels
crafts.base: Finished rare jewels with 3 or 4 good mods
crafts.sale: A good implicit can double the price
steps: Take finished jewels you were going to sell anyway
Vaal Orb each one
Price the good implicits up (for example immunity to Corrupted Blood or Maim), sell the rest as normal
crafts.targets: Corrupted implicits that remove a passive point
crafts.buyers: Min-maxers

alts.name: Only corrupt mid jewels
alts.why: Don't Vaal your best jewels. A brick costs more than the implicit adds.
steps: Corrupt only jewels worth under a few div
Sell your best jewels clean

crafts.name: Minion wands
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ Convoking Wand
steps: Orbs of Alteration until +1 to minion gems plus a minion damage mod
Regal for a third mod
Bench craft or exalt the rest
crafts.targets: +minion gem levels, minion damage and attack/cast speed
crafts.buyers: Minion builds, usually some of the most played

alts.name: Buy magic +1 wands
alts.why: Same trick as caster wands: pay for a sure +1 base.
steps: Buy magic Convoking Wands with +1 and an open slot
Regal and bench craft

alts.name: Chaos reforge
alts.why: Better for chasing +2 with high minion damage.
steps: Chaos Orbs until +gem level plus minion damage
Bench craft the rest

crafts.name: Spell suppression boots and gloves
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ evasion or evasion hybrid boots and gloves
steps: Orbs of Alteration until spell suppression plus life
Regal for a third mod
Bench craft a resistance or movement speed
crafts.targets: Spell suppression, life, resistances and movement speed on boots
crafts.buyers: Attack builds that cap suppression

alts.name: Chaos reforge
alts.why: Faster for full rares with two resistances.
steps: Chaos Orbs until suppression, life and a resistance
Bench craft the last mod

alts.name: Shuddering Fossil boots
alts.why: More speed mods, so you hit movement speed alongside more often.
steps: Shuddering Fossil in a Primitive Chaotic Resonator
Keep movement speed plus suppression

crafts.name: Bow quivers
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ meta quiver bases
steps: Orbs of Alteration until life plus a bow damage mod
Regal, then bench craft crit or attack speed
Exalt the open prefix if the base is great
crafts.targets: Life, crit multiplier and bow damage
crafts.buyers: Bow builds, which are usually common

alts.name: Essence of Zeal
alts.why: Guarantees attack speed, which most bow builds want here.
steps: Essence of Zeal until life or crit multi lands alongside
Bench craft the rest

crafts.name: Life and crit amulets
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ Onyx, Agate, Turquoise or Marble Amulets
steps: Essence of Greed for guaranteed life
Keep rolls with crit multiplier or two resistances alongside
Bench craft the last mod, then add a Catalyst
crafts.targets: Life, crit multi, resistances and a useful implicit
crafts.buyers: Crit builds and life builds

alts.name: Alt and regal
alts.why: Cheaper. Aim for life plus crit multi on magic, then regal.
steps: Orbs of Alteration until life plus crit multi
Regal and bench craft

alts.name: Chaos reforge
alts.why: Better for full rares with resistances.
steps: Chaos Orbs until three good mods
Bench craft the fourth

crafts.name: Labyrinth enchant flips
crafts.base: Strong rare helmets and boots with no enchant
crafts.cost: Your lab run plus the item
crafts.sale: 1 to 10 div more with a meta enchant
steps: Buy good unenchanted helmets for meta skills
Run the Eternal Labyrinth and enchant them
Relist with the meta skill enchant
crafts.targets: Helmet enchants for the top skills on poe.ninja
crafts.buyers: Meta build players in week 1 and 2

alts.name: Sell lab runs
alts.why: Offer the enchant as a service in trade chat instead of buying items.
steps: Advertise enchant runs for buyers' own helmets
Charge a flat fee per run

crafts.note: Check that the Labyrinth enchants still work the same once 3.30 is live.

crafts.name: Max-resistance ES body armour
crafts.base: High item level Twilight Regalia (about 20c for the base)
crafts.cost: About 12 div per finished chest at 3.29 prices
crafts.sale: 20 to 60+ div for +2% max res with high ES
steps: Roll energy shield prefixes first (essences or a Dense Fossil), keeping a good ES base
Use Grand Eldritch Embers until the +% to all maximum Resistances implicit lands
Finish the open slots with Exalted Orbs or bench crafts
crafts.targets: +1 to +2% to all maximum resistances implicit, high ES, physical taken as chaos
crafts.buyers: Every ES build, including the Cold DoT Occultist
crafts.note: A 3.29 planner craft of this chest came to about 11.7 div all in. The Ember count depends on luck.

alts.name: Dense Fossil base first
alts.why: Gives a higher ES roll before the Ember spam, so each hit sells for more.
steps: Dense Fossil in a Primitive Chaotic Resonator until a high %ES prefix
Bench craft the open suffix
Grand Eldritch Embers until max resistances lands

alts.name: Essence of Woe base
alts.why: Cheapest way to a high flat ES roll on the chest.
steps: Essence of Woe until the flat ES roll is high
Exalt or bench craft the rest
Grand Eldritch Embers for the max resistances implicit

crafts.name: Energy shield helmets
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ top ES helmet base
steps: Essence of Woe for a guaranteed high flat ES
Keep any roll with %ES or a second ES prefix alongside
Bench craft the last mod, then Eldritch implicits
crafts.targets: Flat ES, %ES, resistances, then a good Eldritch implicit
crafts.buyers: CI and ES stacker builds
crafts.note: Essence of Woe is the cheapest way to a high flat ES roll. A top %ES roll is roughly a 1 in 40 hit.

alts.name: Dense Fossil
alts.why: More expensive per roll but hits %ES and flat ES together more often.
steps: Dense Fossil in a Primitive Chaotic Resonator
Keep double ES rolls
Bench craft, then implicits

alts.name: Implicit flip
alts.why: Buy finished ES helmets and only add Eldritch implicits.
steps: Buy helmets with good ES and resistances but no implicits
Greater Embers and Ichors until a usable implicit pair
Relist with the implicits shown

crafts.name: Fossil ES spirit shields
crafts.base: ilvl 86+ Titanium Spirit Shield
steps: Put Dense Fossils in Primitive Chaotic Resonators and reroll the shield
Stop when you hit 2 to 3 energy shield prefixes
Bench craft the missing ES prefix or quality, then finish suffixes with resistances
crafts.targets: 2 to 3 high ES prefixes, spell block, resistances
crafts.buyers: Caster and ES builds that use a shield

alts.name: Essence of Woe
alts.why: Guarantees flat ES, which is half of what spirit shield buyers want.
steps: Essence of Woe on ilvl 84+ spirit shields
Keep rolls with %ES or spell damage alongside
Bench craft or exalt the rest

crafts.name: Abyssal socket gear
crafts.base: High item level helmets, gloves or boots for Intelligence stackers
steps: Reroll the base with a Hollow Fossil to get an abyssal socket
Keep items that also roll the stat you're after (Intelligence, ES, resistances)
Finish with exalts or bench crafts
crafts.targets: Abyssal socket plus Intelligence and energy shield
crafts.buyers: Intelligence stackers and abyss jewel builds

alts.name: Hollow plus Dense
alts.why: Lokati-style best-in-slot pieces: the abyssal socket and high ES together.
steps: Hollow and Dense Fossils in a Potent Chaotic Resonator
Keep the socket plus high ES
Finish with a bench craft and an Eldritch implicit

alts.name: Buy a socketed base
alts.why: Cheaper on day 3+ when lots of abyssal socket rares are listed.
steps: Buy a rare with the abyssal socket and one open side
Exalt or bench craft the open side
Add an Eldritch implicit before you sell

crafts.name: Twice-corruption gambles
crafts.base: 20/20 or 21/20 gems, and cheap uniques that become valuable with a second corruption
crafts.sale: Big swings, a few hits pay for many bricks
steps: Vaal Orb a 20/20 gem first
Lapidary Lens can now corrupt it a second time, but it can also destroy the gem
Sell 21/23 and 22/20 results, write off the rest
crafts.targets: +2 levels or 23% quality on meta gems
crafts.buyers: Rich players min-maxing meta skills
crafts.note: New in 3.30: the Altar of Corruption and the Lapidary Lens can corrupt an already corrupted item or gem again. Corrupted items can't go in the Recombinator anymore.

alts.name: Uniques at the Altar of Corruption
alts.why: Peppino-style unique gambling, now with a second corruption on the Temple altar.
steps: Buy a stack of a cheap unique with strong corrupted implicits
Corrupt at the Altar of Corruption
Corrupt the good ones a second time and sell the hits

crafts.name: High pDPS attack weapons
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ meta attack weapons (claws, daggers, one-hand swords, bows)
steps: Essence of Contempt for guaranteed high flat physical damage
Keep rolls with high % physical damage alongside
Bench craft attack speed or crit, then sell or exalt
crafts.targets: T1 % phys, high flat phys, attack speed, crit
crafts.buyers: Physical attack builds

alts.name: Jagged Fossil
alts.why: More physical mods and no chaos mods, so the hits come in pairs.
steps: Jagged Fossil in a Primitive Chaotic Resonator
Keep double phys prefixes
Bench craft the suffix

alts.name: Lock and slam
alts.why: Once you have two great prefixes, lock them and reroll the suffixes.
steps: Use the 2 div two-prefix lock
Reroll for attack speed and crit
Exalt any open slot

crafts.name: Gem-level bows and staves
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ meta bows and staves
crafts.sale: 10 to 100+ div for high gem levels
steps: Orbs of Alteration until a +gem level mod for the right skill type
Regal, then lock the gem mod with the 1 div single lock
Reroll the rest for damage or a second +gem mod
crafts.targets: +levels to socketed or skill-type gems plus damage
crafts.buyers: Bow and spell builds that scale gem levels

alts.name: Faceted Fossil
alts.why: More gem-level mods, which is exactly what these items want.
steps: Faceted Fossil in a Primitive Chaotic Resonator
Keep two gem-level mods

alts.name: Recombine
alts.why: Merge two items that each have one gem-level mod.
steps: Make two bases with one gem-level mod each, same affix pattern
Recombine in predictable mode

crafts.name: Veiled mod crafts
crafts.base: Rares with two great mods and space for a Betrayal veiled mod
steps: Veiled Chaos Orb rerolls the item and adds one veiled mod
Keep rolls with your target mods plus the veil
Unveil at the crafting bench and pick the best option
crafts.targets: Veiled hybrid mods buyers can't get any other way
crafts.buyers: Endgame players with gaps a normal mod can't fill

alts.name: Run Betrayal for the veils
alts.why: Veiled mods only come from Betrayal in 3.30, so the safehouse items are your supply.
steps: Run Betrayal and pick up veiled items
Unveil and keep the good ones as bases

crafts.name: Double-influence gear (Awakener's Orb)
crafts.base: A donor with a single influence mod and a receiver of another influence, ilvl 86+
steps: Prepare a donor with exactly one influence mod, and a receiver of a different influence with the mod you want
Use the Awakener's Orb on the donor (it's destroyed), then apply it to the receiver
The receiver keeps one random influence mod from each item, so set up reset points first
Optional: use an Orb of Dominance to elevate one influence mod. It removes another at random
crafts.targets: Classic pairs: Hunter spell crit with Redeemer aura effect on Vaal Regalia, or elevated resistances with elevated attack crit on armour
crafts.buyers: Rich players chasing best-in-slot bases
crafts.note: Awakener's Orbs only drop from Sirus, so supply is thin. A donor with more than one influence mod makes the carried mod random.

alts.name: Influenced Exalt slams
alts.why: Cheaper. Add one influence mod at a time instead of merging two items.
steps: Start from a rare with an open slot
Use the influenced Exalted Orb for the mod you want
Lock and repeat for the next mod

crafts.name: +4 Focused amulets
crafts.base: Focused Amulet from Heist curio displays: 2 prefixes, 1 suffix, explicit mods doubled
crafts.sale: 50 to 300+ div for meta skill types
steps: Orbs of Alteration until a +gem level mod lands (it shows doubled on this base)
Regal, then lock that mod with the new 1 div single-mod bench craft
Reroll the rest for the second +gem level mod, then finish the suffix
crafts.targets: Two +gem level mods for one skill type (+4 total), good suffix
crafts.buyers: Gem-level builds: minions, spells, DoT
crafts.note: The 3.29 videos used Allflame strands, which aren't in 3.30. This route uses the new bench locks instead, at 1 div per locked mod.

alts.name: Recombine two +2s
alts.why: Make two amulets with one +2 each, which is easy, then merge them.
steps: Craft two Focused Amulets with one +gem level mod each, same affix pattern
Recombine in predictable mode
Pick the base with the higher item level, since the result keeps it in 3.30

alts.name: Buy a +2 and finish
alts.why: Fastest. You pay the seller's margin but skip the alteration grind.
steps: Buy a +2 Focused Amulet with an open prefix
Lock the +2 for 1 div and reroll for the second

crafts.name: Fractured crafting bases
crafts.base: 4-mod rares with one top-tier mod crafters want (rings, boots, gloves, amulets)
steps: Buy cheap 4-mod rares that carry one T1 mod and three junk mods
Fracturing Orb locks one of the four at random
If the T1 mod fractures, sell it as a base. If not, sell it on cheap or scrap it
crafts.targets: Fractured T1 life, movement speed, ES or +gem level mods
crafts.buyers: Crafters building endgame items
crafts.note: Fractured bases are harder to get in 3.30, which raises their value. Tier 5 magic items can now drop fractured, though, so pick those up early.

alts.name: Fractured ground drops
alts.why: Tier 5 magic items can now drop fractured. Pick them up and finish them yourself.
steps: Loot-filter Tier 5 magic items in the slots crafters want
Keep the ones with a strong fractured mod
Regal and essence or exalt the rest, or sell as a fractured base

crafts.name: Exceptional Eldritch implicits
crafts.base: Already-good rare helmets, gloves and boots on popular bases
steps: Buy finished rares with good explicit mods but weak implicits
Use Exceptional Eldritch Embers and Ichors to roll top implicits
Resell, or keep the item for your own build
crafts.targets: Top-tier Exarch and Eater implicits that suit the item's build
crafts.buyers: Players finishing their endgame gear

alts.name: Grand Embers and Ichors
alts.why: Much cheaper per roll for mid-tier buyers who don't need the top implicit.
steps: Grand Eldritch Ember and Ichor until both sides hit a usable tier
Stop at decent rolls, then sell
Save Exceptionals for items already worth 50+ div

crafts.name: Recombinator 5-mod items
crafts.base: Two items of the same base type with matching affix patterns
crafts.sale: Hundreds of div for meta slots
steps: Build halves cheaply: one with your best prefixes, one with your best suffixes
Match the affix pattern (2 prefix + 1 suffix with 2 prefix + 1 suffix)
Recombine in predictable mode, then bench craft the last slot
crafts.targets: Five or six tier 1 mods on a meta base
crafts.buyers: Players at the top of the economy
crafts.note: In 3.30 the result always keeps the item level of the base you choose, and corrupted items can't be recombined.

alts.name: Unpredictable mode
alts.why: Higher ceiling for a jackpot, but a total miss is possible.
steps: Only use it on cheap halves
Keep a spare half ready to try again

alts.name: Sell the halves
alts.why: Recomb crafters buy good halves all league. Less risk, smaller profit.
steps: Craft clean 2+1 halves of meta bases
List them as recomb material

crafts.name: Influenced meta boots
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ boots with Hunter or Redeemer influence
steps: Make a rare boot with movement speed, life and resistances
Add an influence mod buyers want, for example Tailwind or Elusive, with the matching influenced Exalted Orb
Finish with a bench craft and an Eldritch implicit
crafts.targets: Movement speed, life, resistances plus a premium influence mod
crafts.buyers: Rich crit and attack players

alts.name: Buy a one-influence base
alts.why: Start from boots that already have the influence mod and craft around it.
steps: Buy boots with the influence mod and open slots
Lock it with the 1 div single lock and reroll the rest

crafts.name: Mirror-tier items and mirror services
crafts.base: A double-elevated or otherwise near-perfect base
crafts.sale: Mirrors, or a fee per copy as a mirror service
steps: Start from a top base (two elevated influence mods or the best fracture you can buy)
Finish the open mods with bench locks (1 div per side in 3.30) and exalts, aiming for 6 top-tier mods
Add Exceptional Eldritch implicits
Mirror it once and list the copy, or offer it as a mirror service and charge a fee per copy
crafts.targets: Six top-tier mods plus top implicits for a meta build
crafts.buyers: The richest players in the league
crafts.note: Not a week 1 project. Plan for it once you have 500+ div and know which builds will be meta late in the league.

alts.name: Recombinator finish
alts.why: Merge two strong halves instead of paying for locks on every attempt.
steps: Make one item with perfect prefixes and one with perfect suffixes, same base
Recombine in predictable mode
Corrupted items can't go in, so corrupt only after you're done

crafts.name: Mirror-tier jewels
crafts.base: Abyss, cluster or regular jewels with 3 near-perfect mods
crafts.sale: Mirrors, or a fee for each copy
steps: Make two jewels with two perfect mods each
Recombine for 4 perfect mods
Sell as a mirror service
crafts.targets: Four perfect mods for a meta build
crafts.buyers: The richest players in the league

alts.name: Exalt and lock
alts.why: For jewels that already have 3 perfect mods.
steps: Lock both sides you want to keep
Exalt for the last perfect mod

avoid: Allflame crafting isn't in 3.30, so skip any video step that uses strands or Ducats.
Chance Orbs are much rarer now and can't be bought from vendors, so this gets expensive fast.
Veiled mods now only come from Betrayal, so supply is thin early on.
Prefix or suffix locks cost 1 div each now. Only use them on items worth 10+ div.
Mercenaries were nerfed, and demand for their claws, chests and shields will drop.
Tiered drops make decent rares much more common. Craft specific combinations instead.
Big Eldritch and recombinator projects on day 1
Expensive and thin at the start. Wait until prices settle around day 4 or 5.
selling: Look up the cheapest 5 to 10 comparable items and list just under them.
Prices on almost everything fall as supply grows, so take today's price.
Set them and wait 30 to 60 minutes for better rates on essences and exalts.
Log each batch on the Portfolio tab so you can see which craft earns the most per hour.
Drop a craft when its margin goes
If a stack hasn't sold within a few hours, cut the price and move on.
